# pbn

# pbn

**An R analysis framework built for AI agents.**

An AI agent can write most of the code of an analysis. pbn (“paint by
numbers”) makes that code checkable. It gives each project one layout,
rules that code enforces, and fake data with known answers that runs
through the same code as the real data.

This is a trial version. It holds the smallest set of functions that one
real project can use.

## What pbn does

- **One way to do each thing.** One run script, four data steps, and
  [`pbn::folder()`](https://www.rwhite.no/pbn/reference/folder.md) for
  every path to the data. An agent has fewer choices to get wrong.
- **Checks that name the fix.**
  [`pbn::check_project()`](https://www.rwhite.no/pbn/reference/check_project.md)
  checks the project folder against the rules in `pbn.yml`. Checks
  between the data steps stop a run that breaks a rule. Each error names
  the rule and the file.
- **Verification on fake data.** The real data is one scenario among
  fake ones with known answers. `expect_` functions check each fake
  scenario, and
  [`pbn::read_results()`](https://www.rwhite.no/pbn/reference/read_results.md)
  does not read the results of a scenario with a failed assertion.
- **Records to review.** Each run writes `check.csv` with every
  assertion, a run log `run.md`, and a manifest with the md5 of the
  code. A person reviews these, not only the changed lines.
- **The data stays on its server.** An agent works on the code and the
  fake scenarios, and needs no real data.
  [`pbn::to_one_file()`](https://www.rwhite.no/pbn/reference/to_one_file.md)
  writes the run of the real data as one script for a server without a
  network.

pbn is the one policy package of its family. `org` (paths), `cohort`
(exclusions) and `plnr` (plans) are mechanism packages without opinions.

## For an AI agent

Read <https://www.rwhite.no/pbn/articles/pbn.md> before you write or
change the run script of an analysis project. It is the manual of pbn as
one worked example, in plain Markdown, built for an agent to read in one
piece. <https://www.rwhite.no/pbn/llms.txt> lists every other page.

## Installation

``` r
pak::pak("raubreywhite/pbn")
```

## Quick start

A project version has a run script `v01_run.R` and a folder
`v01_functions/`. `v01_functions/_cfg.R` names the scenarios in
`CFG$scenarios`: the real data, and fake data that the project makes
itself. The run script is one `plnr` plan over every scenario and
simulation. Its data steps read the data, clean it and build a `cohort`:

``` r
pbn::initialize_project(version = "v01", home = ".", folders = c(main = "../data"))
scenarios <- pbn::scenarios(CFG)

p <- plnr::Plan$new()
pbn::add_data(p, "d", raw = data_raw, clean = data_clean, cohort = data_cohort)
pbn::add_analyses(p, scenarios, name = "models", fn = fit_models, outcome = CFG$outcomes)
r <- pbn::run_plan(p)
pbn::save_results(r, p, scenarios)

pbn::make_outputs(make_output, scenarios)
```

The file `pbn.yml` in the project folder names the rules of
[`pbn::check_project()`](https://www.rwhite.no/pbn/reference/check_project.md),
as one line: `extends: house_2026_11_17`. From the project folder, run
the script with `Rscript v01_run.R`, and check the layout with
[`pbn::check_project()`](https://www.rwhite.no/pbn/reference/check_project.md).

## Read next

- [Get started](https://www.rwhite.no/pbn/articles/pbn.html): the
  manual. It builds a small fake project file by file, and runs it.
- [pbn with AI agents](https://www.rwhite.no/pbn/articles/agents.html):
  the layers of pbn, and three mistakes of an agent that pbn stops.
- [Reference](https://www.rwhite.no/pbn/reference/index.html): every
  function. The help page of each function holds its rules.

# Package index

## Run a project version

- [`initialize_project()`](https://www.rwhite.no/pbn/reference/initialize_project.md)
  : Start a project version
- [`folder()`](https://www.rwhite.no/pbn/reference/folder.md) : The path
  of a folder of the project
- [`scenarios()`](https://www.rwhite.no/pbn/reference/scenarios.md) :
  Choose the scenarios of a run
- [`end_unless_real()`](https://www.rwhite.no/pbn/reference/end_unless_real.md)
  : End the run script here unless the real data ran

## The plan

- [`add_data()`](https://www.rwhite.no/pbn/reference/add_data.md) : Add
  data to a plan
- [`cohort_data()`](https://www.rwhite.no/pbn/reference/cohort_data.md)
  [`keep_exclusions()`](https://www.rwhite.no/pbn/reference/cohort_data.md)
  : Work on the data of a cohort and keep its exclusion table
- [`add_analyses()`](https://www.rwhite.no/pbn/reference/add_analyses.md)
  : Add one analysis for each scenario and simulation to a plan
- [`run_plan()`](https://www.rwhite.no/pbn/reference/run_plan.md) : Run
  a plan
- [`progress()`](https://www.rwhite.no/pbn/reference/progress.md) : Show
  the progress inside one analysis
- [`get_data()`](https://www.rwhite.no/pbn/reference/get_data.md)
  [`get_argset()`](https://www.rwhite.no/pbn/reference/get_data.md) :
  Get the data or the argset of one analysis at the console

## Results

- [`save_results()`](https://www.rwhite.no/pbn/reference/save_results.md)
  : Save the results of a run
- [`read_results()`](https://www.rwhite.no/pbn/reference/read_results.md)
  : Read the results object of a project version
- [`check_results()`](https://www.rwhite.no/pbn/reference/check_results.md)
  : Check a results object against the contract
- [`render_run()`](https://www.rwhite.no/pbn/reference/render_run.md) :
  Render the run log to a PDF

## Checks of fake scenarios

- [`expect_recovers()`](https://www.rwhite.no/pbn/reference/expect_recovers.md)
  : Check that an analysis recovers the truth of a fake scenario
- [`expect_biased()`](https://www.rwhite.no/pbn/reference/expect_biased.md)
  : Check that a control analysis shows its bias

## Output

- [`make_outputs()`](https://www.rwhite.no/pbn/reference/make_outputs.md)
  : Write the output of the real data and of chosen fake scenarios
- [`stamp_fake()`](https://www.rwhite.no/pbn/reference/stamp_fake.md) :
  Mark a figure of fake data

## Running on an air-gapped server

- [`to_one_file()`](https://www.rwhite.no/pbn/reference/to_one_file.md)
  : Write the run of the real data as one file for a server
- [`check_one_file()`](https://www.rwhite.no/pbn/reference/check_one_file.md)
  : Check the file of to_one_file() on this computer
- [`show_blocks()`](https://www.rwhite.no/pbn/reference/show_blocks.md)
  [`show_block()`](https://www.rwhite.no/pbn/reference/show_blocks.md) :
  Show the numbers of the manuscript, one block at a time

## Checks of the layout

- [`check_project()`](https://www.rwhite.no/pbn/reference/check_project.md)
  : Check a project against the house layout

## Shared helpers

- [`table1()`](https://www.rwhite.no/pbn/reference/table1.md) : Compute
  the numbers of a descriptive table
